research_question: What prediction and attribution reference supports the study?
limitation: Prediction discrimination measures a different outcome from explanation faithfulness.

research_question: SHAP grounding improves model-feature and direction agreement.
interpretation: Grounded drafts better match the fitted model's signed drivers.

research_question: Verification, correction and fallback improve final agreement and completeness.
interpretation: The final system improved signed agreement and produced complete verified outputs.
limitation: Model revision and deterministic fallback have different delivery outcomes.

research_question: Faithfulness may decline when attributions conflict with clinical expectations.
interpretation: A and B showed losses in this benchmark. C retained agreement under fallback-heavy delivery.
limitation: The synthetic model switch can also change probability.

research_question: Structured errors are detected more reliably and unfamiliar faithful prose is withheld.
comparison: Structured vs narrative; explicit vs release
interpretation: Parser and release behavior diverged on the authored challenge.
limitation: Layer-specific errors have different denominators. No formal between-layer interval was estimated.

research_question: B has higher human-assessed faithfulness than A.
result: The reviewer more often judged grounded drafts faithful.
interpretation: The reviewer more often judged grounded drafts faithful.
limitation: Single reviewer and a selected sample of complete triplets.

research_question: Fallback-heavy verified delivery may have lower readability.
result: Readability declined in C. Delivery source and repetitive wording were not randomized.
interpretation: Readability declined in C. Delivery source and repetitive wording were not randomized.
limitation: Single reviewer and a selected sample of complete triplets.

research_question: Faithfulness and readability may move separately.
result: The endpoints moved in opposite directions.
interpretation: The paired condition-level movements were distinct.
limitation: This comparison does not estimate individual-level dependence.

research_question: Optional synthetic ratings may find plausible but counterintuitive-model-inconsistent prose.
interpretation: The primary human study does not address this hypothesis.
limitation: The synthetic automated benchmark measures a different endpoint.
